data.content_ref: inline:ABSTRACTION: all six priority artifacts (SRC_001–SRC_005 plus the torn-tail gap) inherit a single shared ranking schema — blast radius as a monotonic function of (corrupts-record, bypasses-security, breaks-routing, disables-recovery, observability-gap). The census delta (SRC_004/SRC_005) abstracts to the same observability-gap class as the unimported-functions gap (SRC_003) and the recovery-guard gap (SRC_001), differing only in blast-radius magnitude. Refuted if any artifact's priority assignment cannot be derived from that schema alone — e.g. if SRC_003's routing-rot rank depends on call-graph frequency rather than blast-radius category.
